description: This file provides calculation services related to estimation in a software project. It includes functions to compute line hours, retrieve hourly rates from environment variables or database settings, resolve item-specific rates, and recompute/persist total estimate hours and costs. It interacts with database models such as Estimate, EstimateItem, and Settings, and utilizes asynchronous database sessions.

methods.name: float compute_line_hours( quantity: float, base_hours: float, complexity_factor: float, risk_factor: float, )
methods.description: Calculates the number of hours for a line item based on quantity, base hours, complexity, and risk factors.

methods.name: float _get_env_hourly_rate()
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the hourly rate from the HOURLY_RATE environment variable, defaulting to 0.0 if unavailable or invalid.

methods.name: float get_effective_default_rate(session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the default hourly rate from database settings or environment fallback.

methods.name: float _resolve_item_rate(item: EstimateItem, estimate: Estimate, default_rate: float)
methods.description: Determines the applicable rate for an estimate item, prioritizing item rate, then estimate's hourly rate, and finally default rate.

methods.name: None recompute_and_persist_totals(session: AsyncSession, estimate: Estimate)
methods.description: Recalculates total hours and cost for an estimate and updates the database accordingly.

ctags.name: _resolve_item_rate
ctags.pattern: /^def _resolve_item_rate(item: EstimateItem, estimate: Estimate, default_rate: float) -> float:$/

ctags.name: compute_line_hours
ctags.signature: ( quantity: float, base_hours: float, complexity_factor: float, risk_factor: float, )

ctags.name: recompute_and_persist_totals
ctags.pattern: /^async def recompute_and_persist_totals(session: AsyncSession, estimate: Estimate) -> None:$/
